story:
Infinity Roofing & Cleaning is run by Dan out of Dallas, Georgia, in Paulding County. He still turns up to do the estimates himself, which is why so many of our reviews mention him by name rather than the company's.

We have completed more than 500 roofing projects across North Georgia and processed over 500 storm damage claims. Insurance restoration is the part of this trade most homeowners dread, so it is the part we took the trouble to get good at — we document the damage before the adjuster arrives, meet them on the roof, and keep the claim moving through to settlement.

We also run the exterior cleaning side of the business: soft wash roof cleaning, house washing, driveway cleaning and gutter work. That combination matters more than it sounds. A roofing-only company has no reason to tell you your roof needs a wash rather than a replacement. We do both, so we can give you the honest answer either way.
